method_long: Execution-feedback closed-loop coordination with rotation-synchronized window guidance
note: The only configuration source of round 2 (docs/final_method/ROUND2.md, formal round FORMAL.md): experiments/final.py launches registered configurations only. First-draft (round-1) registry: docs/archive/registry/METHOD_REGISTRY_ROUND1_20261119.json; development-period registry: docs/archive/registry/METHOD_REGISTRY_20261111.json.

ECC.role: proposed method: opportunity coordination (keep / critical-window correction / direct entry) with standard SAC

ECC_NO_CORE.role: attribution: keep and direct entry only (no grid correction)

SAC_MPC.role: w/o feedback: the policy's intent is flown as proposed (same executor, network, reward)

TD3_MPC.role: matched deterministic actor-critic baseline (TD3 standard configuration)

ECC_FINE.role: proposed method with the fine opportunity lattice (FORMAL.md section 8); fills the ECC slot of the formal stage if the short check passes

ECC_V3A.role: round-3 dev (ROUND3.md section 2): direct entry before correction, last usable pass within 32 s

ECC_V3B.role: round-3 dev: v3 rule and a training cost of 2.0 per correction

ECC_NC3.role: round-3 dev: keep and direct entry (32 s lead), no correction

ECC_V4.role: round-3 dev B (ROUND3.md section 3): one last-window rule, intervention feedback on every replacement, window-bounded re-timing
